title: Kodak FunSaver: flash-filled daylight portrait (San Francisco)
description: Young woman photographed close-up on a sunny San Francisco street with the FunSaver's built-in flash firing (photographer's caption: 'My poor flash-blinded roommate'). Shows direct on-camera flash as fill in daylight, hard frontal light on skin, warm 800-speed colour negative and slight edge softness of the plastic lens. Looks freshly processed: a lab print scan, no fading or colour shift.
author: danisabella
notes: Camera identified by the photographer's tags (kodakfunsaver, disposablecamera). The film is not stated; FunSaver cameras sold in the US in 2009 were loaded with Kodak 800-speed colour negative film (Max/Ultramax 800 family), so treat the stock as likely, not confirmed. Largest public Flickr size is the original scan (about 800 x 1200). Flickr title: "My poor flash-blinded roommate.". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded the Flickr original.

title: Kodak FunSaver: indoor flash portrait at night
description: Indoor night-time portrait of a woman in a room, lit by the FunSaver's direct flash: bright, flat light on the face and scarf, quick falloff to the background and the warm, saturated rendering of 800-speed consumer negative film. Representative of single-use camera indoor snapshots. Freshly processed lab scan, no fading.
author: danisabella
notes: Same roll and photographer as disposable-01 (Flickr tags camera, disposable, funsaver, kodak). Film assumed to be the FunSaver's 800-speed Kodak colour negative; not stated by the photographer. Flickr title: "Photo's a bit faily, but whatever.". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded the Flickr original.

title: Kodak FunSaver: indoor flash with mirror
description: Indoor flash snapshot of two people at a mirror in a doorway at night: strong flash on the near subjects, hard shadows, grainy darker surround and warm skin typical of 800-speed consumer negative film. Fresh lab scan.
author: danisabella
notes: Same roll as disposable-02 (taken 2009-11-25). Film assumed, not stated. Flickr title: "Das and the mirror.". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded the Flickr original.

title: Kodak FunSaver: daylight street mural
description: Daylight street scene with a colourful mural and a passer-by: shows the FunSaver look without flash, bright saturated colours, high contrast, lens softness and vignetting toward the corners. Fresh lab scan.
author: danisabella
notes: Same roll as disposable-02/03. Film assumed, not stated. Flickr title: "graffiti on the way to temple". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded the Flickr original.

title: Kodak single-use (Kodak Flash, 800 film): indoor flash on shelves
description: Bedroom shelves with cameras, manga and plush toys lit by the single-use camera's direct flash: saturated primaries (blue and green shelves, yellow wall), hard shadows and flash falloff. Modern processing and scan (2019), no fading.
author: Matthew Paul Argall
notes: Generic Kodak single-use camera, not a FunSaver: the photographer names it 'Kodak Flash Single Use Camera' and tags it kodak800 / 800isofilm (the non-US Kodak single-use model with 800-speed film). Included as a close stand-in because indoor FunSaver flash examples under open licences are scarce. Flickr title: "Cameras, manga, and Garfield". Flickr description: "Just a casual photo taken in my bedroom. Camera used: Kodak Flash Single Use Camera. ". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded a Flickr rendition (largest edge up to 2048 px); the original is larger.

title: Kodak single-use (Kodak Flash, 800 film): daylight classic car

author: Matthew Paul Argall
notes: Photographer's caption: 'Kodak Flash Single Use Camera (preloaded with Kodak 800 film)'. Generic Kodak single-use, not a FunSaver. Flickr title: "1969 Pontiac GTO". Flickr description: "Camera used: Kodak Flash Single Use Camera (preloaded with Kodak 800 film) Location: Olinda, Victoria, Australia. Sometimes on the weekend, there are classic cars parked outside the three pubs in my neighbourhood. Not every weekend though. In this case, I was lucky, as this and a couple other clas". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded a Flickr rendition (largest edge up to 2048 px); the original is larger.

title: Polaroid SX-70 (1976): Dillon's Disco, Westwood
description: Daylight street view of Dillon's Disco and a billboard, December 1976, on original SX-70 film. Shows the soft, low-contrast, slightly green-cyan and warm-highlight palette of 1970s SX-70 prints. Some age is visible (mild yellowing and softness); colours are muted rather than badly shifted. Scan of the image area only; the white frame is cropped off.
author: Alan Light
notes: Photographer states 'Polaroid SX-70 photograph'. 1976 predates Time-Zero (1980), so this is original SX-70 film. Small scan (about 600 px). Flickr title: "Dillon's Disco, December 1976". Flickr description: "After the premiere of A Star Is Born (Streisand version, 1976) guests partied nearby at Dillon's Disco, 1081 Gayley Avenue, Westwood, Los Angeles CA. Today it is an El Pollo Loco restaurant. Polaroid SX-70 photograph.". License confirmed through Flickr oEmbed at download time. Downloaded the Flickr original.

title: Polaroid SX-70 (1978): office interior

author: Alan Light
notes: Caption: 'Polaroid SX-70 photo'. Depicts identifiable people; internal reference use only. Small scan (about 600 px). Commons file: "Chuck Jones (228243289).jpg".

title: Halation diagram (how light scatters back into the red layer)

title: Super 8 (1966-67): Phu Cat Air Base, Vietnam - 10 s excerpt
description: Ten-second excerpt (helicopters and airmen on the flight line in daylight) from an amateur Super 8 reel shot in 1966-67. Shows Super 8 grain, gate shape with rounded corners, softness, exposure breathing and Kodachrome-era colour as transferred. The transfer looks like a projection capture: soft, highlights clip to yellow-white in later scenes, slight warm/yellow cast. Pillarbox removed (cropped to the 4:3 picture).
author: DFP32301
notes: Film stock not stated. Super 8 launched in 1965 with Kodachrome II as Kodak's colour cartridge stock, so Kodachrome II is likely but inferred. Camera not stated (not confirmed as a Kodak Instamatic M-series). Re-encoded to H.264 CRF 16 at native 29.97 fps, no audio. Source time range: 00:03:58-00:04:08. Source video: "Super8 Footage of Phu Cat Air Base, Vietnam, 66-67 (Amateur Film).webm" (1280x720, 381.7 s).

title: Super 8 (1966-67): Phu Cat Air Base stills (frame at 00:00:02)
description: This frame: mountain peak beyond the base under a pale sky.
